subject: Inconsistent detailing of the fire pump discharge piping at Electrical Closet 2A between

messages.text: The fire pump discharge piping shown in Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502 at Electrical Closet 2A isn't detailed consistently with Fire Alarm Riser Diagram FA-501 -- need direction before we release the sprinkler shop drawings. This is becoming a priority as sprinkler rough-in proceeds toward the fire marshal walkthrough. No cost impact is anticipated. This isn't holding up any current sprinkler work. There's no hard deadline on this, but a timely response is appreciated.
